execution.detail: Added NOT VALID (migrations/001_add_fk.sql:1) and validated in a separate transaction (migrations/002_validate_fk.sql:1). VALIDATE CONSTRAINT checks existing rows under a lock that lets writes continue.

message: New FK orders_user_fk on existing table orders (postgres). Adding a FK validates all existing rows under SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE lock.
mitigation: Use ADD CONSTRAINT ... NOT VALID, then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in a separate transaction.
